name: al-folio v1 Migration
title_zh: 学术主页搬家工，Jekyll 老站一键换 al-fo
tagline_zh: 论文列表、个人简介、项目页全给你搬到新主题，连格式带样式一起换。不用手抄一条引用，不用对着文档猜配置。
tagline_en: Move pubs, bio, and projects into al-folio without retyping a single citation. Run once, get a clean deploy-ready.
why_zh: 它读你旧站的结构，把内容映射到 al-folio 的字段，而不是让你手动复制粘贴。迁移过程可重复。
why_en: It parses your old site's structure and maps content into al-folio's fields—no copy-paste. Re-runnable with tweaked configs, so.
limit_zh: 只认 Jekyll 生成的静态站点，且原站需用标准 _config.yml 和 _posts/_projects 目录…
limit_en: Only handles Jekyll static sites with standard _config.yml and _posts/_projects layout. Non-academic content (blog posts, galleries) is skipped.
title_en: Academic homepage migrator: Jekyll to al-folio in one pass
